title: The Abrahamic Covenant
subtitle: Genesis 12-50
theme: God chooses one man to bless all nations. Election, promise, and faith.
memoryText: And he believed the LORD, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
reviewQuestions: What are the three elements of God’s promise to Abraham, and how does each find fulfillment in Christ?
What does the covenant cutting of Genesis 15 reveal about the nature of God’s grace?
How does the story of Joseph function as a type of Christ?
What does it mean that Abraham “believed God and it was counted to him as righteousness”?
psalmsNote: Psalm 105 retells the covenant with Abraham. Psalms 121, 124, 125, and 37 teach trust. Psalms 47 and 66 look to the nations.
